titre: Cartes — L'irréel et les hypothèses (conditionnels mixtes)

cartes.verso: If + présent, will + base verbale. Ex : If it rains, I'll stay in.
If + prétérit, would + base verbale. Ex : If I had time, I'd travel.
If + past perfect, would have + participe passé. Ex : If I had known, I'd have come.

cartes.recto: Règle d'or des propositions en if ?
cartes.verso: Jamais will ni would dans la proposition en if.
Au type 2, be devient were à toutes les personnes en anglais soigné (subjonctif).
If + past perfect, would + BV. Ex : If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
Un regret sur le présent. Ex : I wish I knew the answer (mais je ne la connais pas).
Un regret sur le passé. Ex : I wish I had studied harder.
Un agacement, un souhait de changement chez autrui. Ex : I wish you would stop shouting.
It's high time + prétérit. Ex : It's time we left.
if... not. Ex : Unless you hurry (= if you don't hurry), you'll be late.

cartes.recto: Forme inversée soutenue de « If I had known » ?
cartes.verso: Had I known... (inversion sans if en registre formel).
